business_problem: Generali Switzerland wanted to improve customer-facing insurance service by automating multilingual help with policy selection, customer questions, and claims assistance.
solution_summary: Generali Switzerland deployed “Chatty” as an AI-based chatbot to automate and improve customer-facing insurance service on its website. The assistant was co-developed with startup Enterprise Bot and runs through an integration of DocBrain and ChatGPT, which the source says powers the bot’s generative AI and process automation. In practice, Chatty is the serving layer customers interact with to compare or select insurance policies, ask service questions, and get help in claims scenarios. Customer prompts submitted through the web channel are passed into the integrated AI stack, where ChatGPT generates conversational responses and DocBrain supports the bot’s operation, then answers are returned in the customer’s language. The rollout started on the German site in autumn 2023 and expanded to French, Italian, and English in early 2024. The source does not disclose storage, hosting, or model-governance details.
